findings.text: endpoint_closures is absent from the ready_now rows even though every ready item carries it on the dispatch surface, so a reader querying the field named for the ready set gets nothing; a live read of the reckon project reproduced empty ready_now closure fields, matching the gap the coordinator recorded as the field landing on the adjacent surface.

the test aliases result['immediate_roadmap'] as 'ready', asserting the surface the implementation chose rather than the field the done-when names, so the ready-named surface's silence passed the node's own gate undetected.

justifications.durability: both new gate cases fail at base with KeyError 'endpoint_closures' (tests/test_roadmap.py:743 and tests/test_roadmap.py:824) and the byte-identity case at tests/test_roadmap.py:847 fails if membership is written rather than derived, so a regression of this change fails loudly.
justifications.evidence: the recorded gate asserts only the dispatch surface (tests/test_roadmap.py:767) and the live receipt counts only with_endpoint_closures on immediate_roadmap, so the ready-named surface the done-when names is never measured by the node's own evidence and an independent live read found ready_now carrying zero endpoint_closures.
justifications.fit: the endpoint_memberships index built from the existing _dependency_endpoints rows at reckon/roadmap.py:1498 follows the surrounding idiom, but the new test at tests/test_roadmap.py:767 aliases result['immediate_roadmap'] as 'ready', a name the contract gives to a different field, masking the gap until a live read.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/roadmap.py:1802 adds endpoint_closures to every immediate_roadmap dispatch row while reckon/roadmap.py:1948 returns the ready_now rows raw, so the field is absent from the surface the section's done-when names as the ready set, even though every ready item appears once with its closures on the dispatch queue.
justifications.scope_discipline: commit 51361af0 touches only reckon/roadmap.py and tests/test_roadmap.py and commit 1a9fa39c only the two declared plan and evidence HTML paths, all inside the run's declared write paths.
